name: Iron Body, Iron Mind
body:
Training your body to its limit has manifested in a particularly strong determination.

Prerequisite(s): Endurance, base Fortitude save +3

Benefit(s): You use your Constitution modifier in place of your Wisdom modifier on Will saves and no longer automatically fail a fortitude save on a roll of 1.

Breath of Life: The Vanguard, © 2021, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.
